Mouse drift? That is really a mouse-specific problem which cannot be fixed completely.

You can overcome this by playing a lot though, you need to pay attention to the orientation of the mouse. Always move up/down/left/right but never rotate the mouse. This way you can avoid mouse drift.

Yes, if you mindblock on this you start trying 3* Camellia songs which makes you lose interest in the game if your brain is not the size of Jupiter. Just play maps you find on latest ranked maps and enjoy yourself.
